\section{Allen-style phonon projection sum rule}
For a pristine supercell the folded dynamical matrix eigenstates are
foldings of primitive polarization vectors, hence
\begin{equation} \sum_{k=G+K,\,\mu} W(K,\lambda; k,\mu) = 1 \end{equation}
with $W = |\langle e(k\mu)|v(K\lambda)\rangle|^2$ (numeric worst deviation $4.4e-16$).
Symbolic core: the stacked $6\times 6$ folded eigenbasis of the
pristine 3-cell supercell satisfies $B^{\dag}B = I$ exactly (sympy),
so every branch sum equals the branch norm $1$.
